[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]200 (Hard Night III) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (4.5) |cash = {{Money|75}} on death |spawned_by = [[Null Crook Boss]] |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Null Goon''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Goon''', was an enemy mainly spawned when the [[Null Crook Boss]] dies, meaning it only appeared in [[Outpost 16]] and [[Banlands]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]], though it also spawned naturally in [[Blind Faith]]. While it had lower health than the enemy that summons it, it was faster than it and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Goons stumbled forward in formation. Each carried weapons identical to the originals. One Goon spat on the ground and muttered, "Cheech ain't gonna like this." But as the Null Goons raised their weapons, the originals did the same. "We'll tell 'em we had'ta deliver a pizza." Said another.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Goon''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Pistol Goon]]. It has a black head. It wears a dark purple shirt with a purple tie, black pants and shoes. On its head, it has what appears to be purple claws grabbing it. It has no arms, though certain its animation still play as if it had them. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] & [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *As the '''Null Goon''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, strong towers with hidden detection are recommended against this. **The [[Golden Scout]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Military Base]] can be used against this. *Various methods of giving towers detections can also be used to combat this. **The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers hidden detection. **[[The Sun]] can be used to give every tower all detections, however, do note it also makes the enemies immune to stun, freeze and burn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullGoon1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullGoon2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullGoon3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Goon''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon.
